reviews.text:
We’ve had weekly private walks for over a year and it’s been great.

We always trust our walker Ali with our dog.

Communication with Christine is always easy and clear.

Would definitely recommend!

We booked Christina for last minute cat-sitting service due to our usual cat-sitters pulling out. Christina and her team were so responsive and professional the entire time we were away and took great care of our cat, we were so happy with their service. Our kitty needed a little extra TLC during our trip and Christina’s team were attentive and made sure he was happy and healthy. Highly recommend Walks & Wags, they live up to all of the positive reviews!

I received a gift certificate for private walks after giving birth to my twins.
It was one of the most helpful gift in my early postpartum!! The team was super friendly & accommodating. Quick response time. My dog was always SUPPEEERRR happy going & coming back from walks. I highly recommend the service and the team :)
